facts.rationale: Adds canonical indexing, comparison boundaries, ordered caller behavior, and runtime destination qualification.
facts.value: Calls ftCo_800C97A8, whose exact test is input.lstick[0].x * facing_dir <= p_ftCommonData->x34. Equality accepts; an unordered NaN comparison rejects under ordinary IEEE semantics. Acceptance calls ifSomething to initialize motion_state + 4 and returns true; rejection performs no transition and returns false. HeavyWait0_IASA reaches this check only after its first two checks reject, and true suppresses the subsequent walk check. HeavyTurn is the supported contextual name, not a hard-coded or validated numeric destination.

facts.value: Private static void(HSD_GObj*) transition-entry helper. It borrows the supplied fighter game object, resolves Fighter and the x2CC attribute pointer as ftDonkeyAttributes*, and forwards the same object to ftCo_Turn_Enter. It allocates, frees, retains, and transfers ownership of no object; exclusive attribute ownership is not established.

facts.rationale: Separates exact initialization from downstream callback behavior and accounts for timing boundaries and exceptional floats.
facts.value: Unconditionally calls ftCo_Turn_Enter for attribute motion_state + 4 with zero flags, zero auxiliary value, cargo_hold.x20_TURN_SPEED as frames_to_turn, and zero animation start. The callee initializes common Turn state and changes motion. If the HeavyTurn callbacks run, each positive countdown is decremented and that animation-processing invocation returns without reversing; a later nonpositive comparison path reverses facing once. Zero/negative/NaN timing takes that path immediately under ordinary IEEE semantics, while positive infinity does not count down. The HeavyTurn animation callback can end the action when frames finish, so initialization is not a guarantee of eventual reversal.
